faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 19 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment is Online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 35 years. Age relaxation applies as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: The salary for JRF is (37,000 INR + 20 % HRA)/month for the first two years, and (42,000 INR + 20 % HRA)/month for the third year.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need BE/BTech/ME/MTech/MS/MCA/MSc with GATE (CS, DA, EC, EE) or NET (Computer Science, Electronic Science, Mathematical Sciences) qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on merit, followed by an interview conducted via Video Conferencing.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) posts.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF by clicking the "Click here" link under the "Official Notification PDF" section in the Important Links table.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: The official website for Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad is https://www.iitism.ac.in. You can visit it for more details and to apply.
